descriptionChirho: The proper name of the national deity of Moab, frequently mentioned in contexts of idolatry and divine judgment. Appears in Numbers 21:29, Judges 11:24, 1 Kings 11:7,33, 2 Kings 23:13, and Jeremiah 48:7,13,46. All occurrences, including variant prepositional forms (for Chemosh, of Chemosh, and to Chemosh) and the ketiv variant spelling, refer to the same Moabite god. Multilingual glosses are consistent: Arabic كَمُوش, Korean 그모시/게모시, Spanish Quemos/Kemosh, Hindi कमोश.
